newsitem.title: USA: Nev. Mohave 750 MW coal unit 1 holding at 615 MW.
newsitem.headline: Nev. Mohave 750 MW coal unit 1 holding at 615 MW.

text.p: The 750 megawatt (MW) unit 1 at the Mohave coal-fired power plant in Nevada was at 615 MW early Friday, where it was expected to hold, a spokesman for the plant said Friday.
The unit, which was shut early Saturday for maintenance, was restarted Thursday afternoon.
The plant's other 750 MW unit was at 735 MW on Friday morning, where it was also expected to remain pending any request from Mohave's owners to increase generation.
Edison International's Southern California Edison Co is the majority owner and operator of the Mohave plant.
